auth.artCaption: Your university community, one secure vote at a time.
auth.forgotPasswordLead: Enter your username, email or student ID and we will send a verification code to the phone number on your account.
auth.loginLead: Sign in to vote, follow your clubs and see the results.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.
auth.passwordResetNotice: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password.
auth.phoneHint: An Egyptian mobile number. We will send a verification code to it.
auth.phoneOnAccount: the phone number on your account
auth.registerLead: Register with your university details to start voting.
auth.registeredNotice: Your account is ready. Sign in to continue.
auth.registeredToast: Phone verified. Your account has been created.
auth.resetCodeIntro: If the account exists, a verification code was sent by SMS to
auth.resetPasswordLead: Enter the code we sent and choose a new password.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.usernameHint: 3–30 characters: letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
auth.verifyPhoneLead: To protect every vote, we confirm that the mobile number belongs to you.

landing.howLead: From registration to results, every step is designed to be simple, fair and verifiable.
landing.lead: Vote in university and club elections, join the clubs you care about and follow the results, safely from any device.

fair.text: Voting windows are enforced by the server clock, and results are shown only when they are meant to be.
fair.title: Fair and on time

oneVote.text: Every vote is confirmed with a one-time code sent to your phone, and each person can vote only once per election.
oneVote.title: One person, one vote

privacy.text: The record that you voted is stored separately from what you chose, so the ballot box does not show who picked what.
privacy.title: Private by design

clubs.text: Subscribe to up to two clubs to take part in their elections.
clubs.title: Join your clubs

register.text: Create your account with your student details and verify your phone.
register.title: Register

results.text: Follow the results as soon as they are published.
results.title: See the results

vote.text: Choose your option and confirm it with a one-time code.
vote.title: Cast your vote
